text: Solicitation Issued: December 21, 2023 Solicitation Closed: February 16, 2024 Number of Addenda Issued: One (1) Number of Bids: Four (4)

The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Rescind its July 31, 2024, Item BA90.4 decision to award Collaborative Procurement from Kinetic GPO Request for Standing Offers Number 23-15 to Sweet Pete’s Bike Shop, due to stating incorrect Supplier name; and 2. Grant authority to award Collaborative Procurement from Kinetic GPO Request for Standing Offers Number 23-15 to 1217563 Ontario Inc. operating as Sweet Pete’s Bicycle Shop for the Supply and Delivery of Various Manual and Electric Bikes, Accessories, and Services for Various City Divisions.
